summary: Iteration 27 backend testing — new /api/accounting/* module (comptabilité + TVA + récurrences + import réservations + scan IA reçu Claude Sonnet 4.6). 11/11 tests passing (meta, transactions CRUD with HT/VAT split, month filter with property_name/owner_name, PUT recalculation, DELETE + 404, summary P&L + TVA + by_category/by_property/by_owner, recurring create/materialize/idempotent/PUT/DELETE, import-revenues idempotency, real vision scan-receipt returning {supplier:'SUPERMARCHE CARREFOUR', date:'2026-01-14', amount_ttc:16.05, vat_amount:2.39, vat_rate:5.5, currency:'EUR', category_guess:'Alimentation / Courses'}). All acceptance criteria from the review request are met.

minor.issue: MIME sniffing is done via substring only on content_type (png/webp/else jpeg). If the client sends 'image/svg+xml' or a wrong content_type, we still forward as image/jpeg. Not blocking (the model rejects gracefully) but could return 415 on unsupported types.
_materialize_recurring is called on every LIST call. For a heavy owner with many active recurrences, this is O(recs × months). Consider caching last materialize timestamp per user.

'by_owner' bucket resolution uses owner_id if present, otherwise falls back to the property's owner. If a manual transaction has NO property_id AND NO owner_id, it goes into '_none' bucket labelled 'Non affecté' — acceptable but worth noting for the UI.

action_items: No blocking action. Optional: return 415 on unsupported receipt MIME types; optional: throttle _materialize_recurring calls (per-user cache) to avoid recomputing on every GET.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/accounting.py:66-71 — _split_tva rounds twice (ttc then ht) then computes vat as (ttc-ht); with 105.5/5.5% this gives HT=100.00, VAT=5.50 (verified). OK, but note the small drift on very large amounts (e.g. 999.99 / 20% -> HT=833.33, VAT=166.66; TTC does not exactly reconcile). Fine for consumer receipts.
backend/routers/accounting.py:141-163 — _materialize_recurring does N find_one lookups per due date. Consider a single find with $in on dates, or a compound index (user_id, recurring_id, date).

backend/routers/accounting.py:238-244 — DELETE returns 404 correctly on missing tx (verified). Note that recurring-generated transactions can be deleted by the user; the next GET will regenerate them (idempotent by date). This is expected but worth documenting in the UI (‘Cette écriture est récurrente, elle sera régénérée’).

backend/routers/accounting.py:335-343 — DELETE /accounting/recurring supports keep_generated=false — good. But when keep_generated=true (default) and start_date is later moved back via PUT, previously deleted months will be re-created. Acceptable.
backend/routers/accounting.py:349-390 — import-revenues excludes only 'annulee' and 'demande' statuses. Confirm that pending/hold states (e.g. 'option') are intentionally included as revenue.
backend/routers/accounting.py:271 — vision prompt uses a strict JSON schema; the endpoint gracefully returns empty strings if the model returns malformed JSON (verified by code path 282-297).
seed_data_creation: All entries prefixed with TEST_QA and cleaned in module-scope teardown (both manual tx and recurring rec + generated tx via keep_generated=false).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter27_accounting.py for regression on the accounting module. It logs into QA Admin, generates a realistic 480x720 JPEG receipt via PIL (SUPERMARCHE CARREFOUR ticket) and performs ONE real Claude Sonnet 4.6 vision call (~budget-conscious). If the Emergent LLM key changes or the vision endpoint is temporarily unavailable, only TestScanReceipt will fail — the rest is pure DB/logic and independent.
